questions.qtext: In a certain code language, 'health is wealth' is written as 'sol liv mah', 'smile good health' is written as 'tim sol gil' and 'cry is not smile' is written as 'mah vil tan gil'. How will 'wealth' be written in the same code language?
questions.solution:
Answer: B

Source solution 1 (score: 0)

-> Common word in (1) & (2) = health
⇒ Common code = sol
health = sol

-> Common word in (2) & (3) = smile
⇒ Common code = gil
smile = gil

-> In (1): health is wealth
Codes = sol liv mah

-> Since health = sol,
Remaining codes = liv, mah
Remaining words = is, wealth

-> "is" is not in the options.
mah → is
liv → wealth

-> Final Answer: B. liv
